rules.label: Contractor notifies the event
rules.note: Eight weeks from becoming aware, unless the Project Manager should have notified it. Check for Z clause amendments.

rules.label: Project Manager replies to the notification
rules.note: One week, or a longer period the Contractor agrees. Failing to reply has consequences under 61.4 - read the clause.

rules.label: Contractor submits the quotation
rules.note: Three weeks from being instructed to submit, unless extended under 62.5.

rules.label: Project Manager replies to the quotation
rules.note: Two weeks from submission, unless extended under 62.5.
